answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by reserving 1,000 distinct operational slots, forcing each to secure a glacier-chilled rack unit exclusively for processing. A verifier monitors capacity via tide-based signals that must return within a specific ms-window, confirming physical occupancy and preventing relay use. Any signal beyond the horizon of accepted latency triggers immediate reservation forfeiture. Honest agents pay 1x cost, while an attacker pays 1,000x for isolated, non-pooled slots.
